results.title: Malabar Gold & Diamonds launches ‘SWAYE’ with Alia Bhatt
results.description: Malabar Gold & Diamonds has launched ‘SWAYE’, a natural diamond jewellery collection inspired by spiral forms. The campaign features actor and brand ambassador Alia Bhatt. Built around the thought ‘Diamonds That Move With You’, the collection comprises lightweight designs intended for different occasions, from everyday wear and work to social gatherings and special occasions. The jewellery uses spiral-inspired forms and open spaces, with pieces designed to be layered or stacked. M. P. Ahammed, chairman, Malabar Group, said: “Today's women seek jewellery that reflects their personal style and adapts to the many occasions that shape their lives. SWAYE draws inspiration from the many roles’ women embrace in their everyday lives. With this collection, we have translated that idea into contemporary jewellery through spiral-inspired forms, open spaces and the brilliance of natural diamonds. The lightweight designs and versatile styling allow each piece to move effortlessly with the wearer, complementing her individual style across occasions and the different facets of her life.” The launch adds to Malabar Gold & Diamonds’ natural diamond jewellery portfolio. The company says its diamonds are 100% natural and responsibly sourced, with its diamond jewellery undergoing 28 quality checks. The brand also highlights its retail policies, including BIS hallmarking with HUID for gold jewellery, diamond testing and certification, 100% value on gold and diamond exchanges, lifetime free maintenance, and transparent pricing.
